summary: La llamada fue bien en lo técnico: dejaste claro el patrón de validar pagos en el servidor y el manejo de links firmados, pero te faltó tener los seis hitos de memoria y decir bien los términos clave (RLS, postMessage, funded). Lo primero a arreglar es el guion de los seis hitos: sin eso, Nathalie no ve que entendés el proyecto y las fechas.

questions.question: Tell me a bit about yourself and your experience.
questions.verdict: Bien: full-stack, seis años, Valley of Guardians y validación en servidor. Faltó el proof concreto (10.000 usuarios, 600 concurrentes), que trabajás solo y la zona horaria.
missing: more than 10,000 users and about 600 at the same time
works alone: no agency, talks to her directly, writes all the code
on Eastern time now, two hours ahead of Denver

questions.question: How do we protect the panels from being copied?
questions.verdict: Bien: bucket privado, única puerta por la API y RLS en la base. Mal: dijiste que la ruta de API 'tiene RLS' y no mencionaste la service role key solo en el servidor.
missing: the API route checks the session and access to that chapter itself
the service role key stays on the server only
no storage policy allows direct reads

questions.question: How do we make sure a panel link doesn't stay valid indefinitely?
questions.verdict: Bien: links que vencen y pedido panel por panel al scrollear. Mal: dijiste 'cada 2 minutos los links se expiran', como si un timer rotara todos; es cada link 120 segundos después de firmarse, y faltó no-store.
missing: each link expires 120 seconds after it is signed, not a global timer
returned with Cache-Control: no-store
keeping going needs a session with access, which leaves a trace

questions.question: How do we ensure a payment confirmed in the browser is secure?
questions.verdict: Bien: el postback del servidor es lo que habilita el acceso. Mal: dijiste 'listen in the iframe' (no se puede leer adentro) y 'same signature' en el front: el navegador solo chequea origin y forma.
missing: our page receives the messages the iframe sends, we cannot read inside the iframe
the browser listener only checks event.origin and the shape of the data
the browser message never unlocks anything, it only tells the screen to check again
while waiting, show 'confirming your payment' for a second or two

questions.question: What are the milestones you need to complete in those six weeks?
questions.verdict: No contestaste: dijiste 'I will cover everything in the paper' y que lo ibas a pensar. Es la respuesta que más tenés que saber de memoria.
missing: five weekly milestones plus a QA week, code on GitHub and Vercel staging every Wednesday
week 1: schema, RLS on every table, 45/55 split, private buckets
week 2: 120-second signed links, protected reader, Sunday leaderboard reset
week 3: upload portal, AI safe/adult scan, auto-cropping, price floors
week 4: Centrobill iframe and postback, paywall at chapter four, 18+ gate
week 5: Paxum payout ledger, ad slots, print-on-demand webhooks
week 6: testing and polish only, sign-off on December 24th

questions.question: How do you handle being blocked and missing a Wednesday?
questions.verdict: Bien: avisás el mismo día y no esperás al miércoles. Faltó el compromiso concreto: código en GitHub y staging cada miércoles con nota en Upwork, y bugs del jueves en tres días hábiles.
missing: every Wednesday before midnight the code is on her GitHub and Vercel staging
a short note on Upwork: what is done, how to test it, what is needed
Thursday bugs fixed within three business days while the next milestone moves on

questions.question: What are the immediate next steps if we move forward?
questions.verdict: Bien: accesos a GitHub, Vercel y Supabase, o los creás y transferís, y arrancás con el primer hito funded. Faltó el contrato en Upwork con los hitos como están publicados y el primer push esta semana.
missing: the contract on Upwork with the milestones as posted
first push this week, and every Wednesday the code is on staging

misconceptions.said: the API route will have row-level security
misconceptions.right: RLS lives in the database (tables and storage.objects); the API route checks the session and access itself and uses the service key on the server.

misconceptions.said: every 2 minutes the links are expired
misconceptions.right: Each link expires 120 seconds after it is signed; there is no global timer rotating all links.

misconceptions.said: we will listen in the iframe of the payment service
misconceptions.right: A page cannot read inside Centrobill's iframe; our page receives the postMessage messages the iframe sends.

misconceptions.said: we will be looking for the same signature and the same data
misconceptions.right: The browser listener checks only event.origin and the shape of the data; signature verification happens on the server postback.

missing: five weekly milestones plus a QA week, code on GitHub and Vercel staging every Wednesday
week 1: schema, RLS on every table, 45/55 split, private buckets
week 2: 120-second signed links, protected reader, Sunday leaderboard reset
week 3: upload portal, AI safe/adult scan, auto-cropping, price floors
week 4: Centrobill iframe and postback, paywall at chapter four, 18+ gate
week 5: Paxum payout ledger, ad slots, print-on-demand webhooks
week 6: testing and polish only, sign-off on December 24th

practice.why: No supiste los seis hitos y es lo que más mira Nathalie para confiar en las fechas.
Dijiste 'cada 2 minutos' como si fuera un timer global; hay que decir que cada link vence 120 segundos después de firmarse y con no-store.
Confundiste el listener del navegador con el postback del servidor y hablaste de firma en el front.
